statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-8927: when a libcurl handle is reused for transfers that take their proxy from environment variables, the Digest proxy authentication state is not cleared between them, so after authenticating to one proxy a later transfer through a different proxy can send it the Proxy-Authorization header meant for the first (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-8927.html). It affects curl 7.12.0 to 8.20.0 and was fixed in curl 8.21.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/5c225384b8d52c67ce8259c6e4203bc57aacb567, which records the environment proxy in a new envproxy field of the transfer state and resets the Digest state when it changes. As of 2026-11-27 the DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. The debug information in curl-dbg shows the envproxy field the fix adds in every build from 8.21.0-r0 on, on x86_64 and aarch64, and in none of the earlier builds, so 8.21.0-r0, the first build of curl 8.21.0, is the first fixed build.

CVE-2026-8927: when a libcurl handle is reused for transfers that take their proxy from environment variables, the Digest proxy authentication state is not cleared between them, so after authenticating to one proxy a later transfer through a different proxy can send it the Proxy-Authorization header meant for the first (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-8927.html). It affects curl 7.12.0 to 8.20.0 and was fixed in curl 8.21.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/5c225384b8d52c67ce8259c6e4203bc57aacb567, which records the environment proxy in a new envproxy field of the transfer state and resets the Digest state when it changes. Debian backported the fix to trixie (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-8927, DSA-6558-1); the Debian changelog records it under 8.14.1-2+deb13u6. The DHI curl packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie curl 8.14.1-2; as of 2026-11-27 the DHI Debian repository publishes three of them (the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 and two rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7) for amd64 and arm64. The two rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7 ship a changelog that records the CVE-2026-8927 fix; the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 does not have it. The first rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7 is the fixed version used here.
